# FLX-2105: golden update without a reason and a changelog row

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

Moving a golden baseline is a deliberate act (KERNEL-SPEC §10): --update-golden requires --reason, and the new baseline must be recorded as a GOLDEN-CHANGELOG.md row naming the components that moved. Without both, a silent regression and an intended change look the same in the history.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2105
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
